checks.name: operator defaults (D7.17) recorded before any code exists
operator backfill creates the five genesis audit heads for both existing organizations once
operator issues a 256-bit code shown once on stdout; storage, dump and list hold only its digest, identifiers, status and counts
resolve_code before scope: known digest names its organization; unknown and malformed resolve to nothing
three pre-signup reservations consume no redemption slot; a foreign or malformed organization refuses without disclosure
pending admission requires the registry-bound verified identity; an unverified mailbox commits no slot, membership or entitlement
a redemption cancelled before commit rolls back: no principal, slot or audit event
verified redemption commits principal, epoch-1 membership, template grants, 30-day entitlement, redemption, audit and exhaustion atomically; the member reads
identical retry returns the stored admission without a second slot; changed payload or another principal refuses; the exhausted code refuses new holds
after a store restart the admission persists and its identical retry still replays
an entitlement that expires after the precheck is refused by the fence's re-read, and an expired entitlement denies the next precheck
operation-first: the operator's entitlement revocation waits on the member fence until the operation commits; the next request (old or new epoch) is refused
code revocation blocks unused pending admissions and new reservations while an already-admitted member's entitlement stays active
revocation-first: the fence waits behind the operator's entitlement revocation and then refuses; entitlement revocation alone denies the member
redemption-first: the operator's code revocation waits on the code row until the redemption commits; the admission stands and the code is then revoked
revocation-first: the redemption waits on the code row behind the revocation and then refuses with no principal, membership or entitlement
two principals racing for the last slot (observed lock wait): exactly one holds it and is admitted, the other is refused as exhausted
two concurrent identical redemptions return one stored admission and consume exactly one slot
reservation expiry, pending-admission expiry (denied for reconciliation) and code expiry refuse; extension is audited and an expired code is never resurrected
sign-out advances only the member's own current epoch; the stale request is refused afterwards; two concurrent sign-outs queue on the member row (one advances, one refuses) without deadlock
an inactive provider binding refuses both the pending admission and the redemption before any definer call
application roles as forged operators are refused by the command and by PostgreSQL (42501); a wrong operator password is refused; nothing was written
operator and admission audit chains recompute from genesis to their heads in both organizations; no issued code appears in a full database dump
